notes.title: Virtual Ricochet Free Forever
notes.notes:
Virtual Ricochet will be leaving Early Access, but not as a full release. Our team of two are no longer developing Virtual Ricochet and have moved on to other opportunities.

We are proud of the vertical slice that we made; Virtual Ricochet is a ready to play wave based shoot-em-up with a final boss. Unfortunately, the game didn’t find an audience and we made the difficult decision to cut our losses and end development before completion as a product worthy of a v1.0 release.

We apologise to the small handful players who took the risk and bought the game in early access expecting additional content. We are sorry that we could not deliver more than what is already available.

What’s next for Virtual Ricochet?

To help more players to have a bit of fun with their VR setup, we plan to make the game free forever!

Despite the shortcomings, we still hope players find enjoyment playing death-defying tennis with robots and laser guns!

Peter and Alec,
Blind Mystics.
